title.narrative: The Gender Gap: Promoting Women’s Access to Land Rights Project

description.narrative: The programme will build up from awareness-building to more practical, income-generating and capacity-strengthening activities while maintaining the initial wards of Insiza District which are ward 7, 8 and 10. Under the sustainable livelihoods pillar, women will receive direct support for dairy farming, fish farming, piggery, goat farming, and mushroom production. EWF will help link women entrepreneurs to bigger markets and assist set up a Women's Hub for shared business operations. Under gender equality pillar, EWF will focus on fostering concrete gender equality outcomes with emphasis on formation of women farmers leadership cycles and peer mentorship between experienced women farmers, gender responsive budgeting, and mental wellness for participants. EWF will support women in business in participating at district and the Zimbabwe International trade fairs to further expose the women to diverse markets. District stakeholders will also be engaged towards co-designing the new programme and reviewing the previous one. Under stronger organisations, EWF will document success stories, conduct staff annual review, invest in staff skills through participating in regional advisory committees and staff wellness support.
